item.title: Keep patched: Geonetwork core-geonetwork: vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via unsafe Saxon XSLT processor configuration in formatter
item.description:
Geonetwork core-geonetwork: RCE · admin required · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 4.4.12, 4.2.17

First step: Update Geonetwork core-geonetwork to 4.4.12 or 4.2.17 or later.

GeoNetwork is a catalog application to manage spatially referenced resources.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-58400
